title: Mật mã và bảo mật thông tin

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply cryptographic principles and techniques, including symmetric and asymmetric encryption, key exchange, and digital signatures.
Analyze and manage security threats, risks, and vulnerabilities in information systems.
Design and implement security protocols for secure communication and data protection.
Identify, assess, and mitigate risks in information security contexts.
Solve complex problems related to cryptography and information security.
Evaluate and analyze cryptographic systems and security measures.
Conduct independent research and develop solutions for cryptographic and security challenges.
Work effectively in teams to solve security-related problems.
Manage and execute security-related projects, including software development and implementation.
Understand and adhere to ethical standards in cryptography and information security.
